biotools.summary: FastConformation is a Python-based toolkit that integrates MSA generation, AlphaFold2 structure prediction, and conformational ensemble analysis in a user-friendly GUI, allowing researchers to iteratively refine subsampling parameters. It facilitates protein conformation predictions and analysis in hours, significantly faster than traditional molecular dynamics simulations.
